name: smoke-test
description: Turns a student team's interview findings into one well-built smoke test and a launch pack designed for their product: the page to publish, posts and print pieces as images, image prompts, captions, setup and boosting steps, and a tracking sheet. Checks the plan independently and reads results against lines set in advance. Leverage by BCE, Berkley Center for Entrepreneurship, NYU Stern.

author.name: Nayan Kanaparthi, Berkley Center for Entrepreneurship, NYU Stern
